== Biography ==
'''Magdalen Glasgow''' was born on 22 Mar 1743 and baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 29 Mar 1743. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-4165|George Glasgow]] and her mother as Margt.<ref name="FMP1" /> The register records both dates; Irvine is inferred from the baptism and is not independently recorded.

Magdalen Glasgow was one of the children recorded to George Glasgow in the Irvine register, alongside [[Glasgow-4121|Isabel]] (1741), [[Glasgow-4126|Mary]] (1745).
